truths.truth: Branches removed as dead code under D-07 were unreachable, so behavior is unchanged
truths.evidence: 74351375 restore.py:226-231 now raises httpauth.CredentialsRefusedError directly where it used to raise decline_error(mgr). decline_error (hqptuner/conf/httpauth.py:109-110) returned NoHttpClientError when mgr.http_client is None, and that check comes before the credentials_ok check. mgr.http_client can become None at runtime: hqptuner/api/routes/connection.py:125 assigns build_http_client(cfg), which returns None when a credential is missing (hqptuner/core/connection.py:156-157). This can happen during the await in _restore_once. The removed 'declined is None' leg was unreachable, but the commit's 'which is what decline_error returned on every reachable path' is not exact: the no-client case now reports a credentials refusal instead of no-client. Narrow race, low impact.
